purpose: Isolated actual-transaction producer receipts for the accepted v3 LOBT parent, fixed v4 GPU residual and source classifier; inputs/outputs must be independently rebuilt and replayed
source_checkout_role: published GPLv3 source and pinned helper code only; no raw, cache, model, prediction or credential bytes are read from this checkout

run_root.canonical_input_layout: Twelve 2025 training months, ranking.parquet, submitting.parquet and independently prepared data/external/weather.parquet beneath the isolated root
run_root.weather_source_receipt: Source URLs and station-year SHA-256 values from independent acquisition
run_root.original_downloader_refused: download_noaa_weather.py binds OUT_DIR to __file__ in the source checkout, so running it with an isolated cwd would write outside the isolated root
run_root.child_process: One allowlisted original Python module at a time with cwd=isolated root, explicit original settings and input/output paths, no shell
run_root.outputs: Fresh stage directory; verify exact source/raw/prior SHA before and after each child, independently replay models and policy, then promote required bytes exclusively to canonical paths; never overwrite or resume a partial stage
run_root.baseline_saved_models: The fresh baseline predict stage aliases independently produced model.json and direct.txt, plus residual.txt whenever the saved baseline model requires it. An independently produced optional residual.txt is promoted and SHA bound with baseline training outputs.
run_root.parent_receipt_publication: Precompute exact GPU/source receipt bytes and validate the complete prospective timestamp parent manifest before writing either receipt; publish exclusive files with readback.

scientific_contract.v3: Published solution, missing, grouped, weather, airport, tail, LIRF, ensemble, LOBT and LOBT blend commands with full intermediate model/OOF/ranking byte provenance; fit excludes each named held pair where applicable, but legacy baseline/missing/weather/airport/LOBT early stopping uses that held pair and other v3 policies select on held labels. The pinned erratum gives each stage's exact validation use. Fixed accepted LOBT valid-disagreement weight 1.0, invalid fallback 1.0 and gap threshold 3600 seconds
scientific_contract.gpu: catboost_gpu.py GPU depth8, 1500 tree cap, seed2026, own-component 6 percent complement-month early stop with at least 20000 and patience120; Jan/Jul eligible selection must be .25, unchanged forward all-finite gain; final all-eligible 1500 trees and fixed .25 ranking blend. Its own heldout exclusion does not make the inherited v3 reference untouched
scientific_contract.source_classifier: catboost_source.py CPU depth7, 600 tree cap, seed2026, own-component LIRF/LTFM valid-AOBT schedule candidate and target-within-60s training class; complement-month 8 percent early stop with at least3000 and patience100; Jan/Jul scale must be .5 and transfer gains positive; final integer median original best_iteration+1; sequential ranking applies fixed GPU .25 then source .5. Its own heldout exclusion does not make the inherited v3 reference untouched
scientific_contract.all_finite_and_ranking: Recompute OOF labels, heldout IDs, model readback and all reported fixed-policy metrics; exact 344841 template order, finite nonnegative output and unchanged invalid/off-gate rows; no ranking label or leaderboard use

upstream_v3_gap.required_next_work: The separately reviewed v3 producer proof adapter must be published together with this pin before real use. It constructs actual transaction receipts for all eleven intermediate stages, replays saved model/OOF and ranking or deterministic formulas, and binds every intermediate output and model role. The current parent driver still refuses its own v3 child stages; only the separately pinned adapter may execute them. No full v3 receipt is accepted until all eleven transactions are proved.

parent_receipts.v3: parents/v3_producer_receipt.json (only from the separately reviewed and published eleven-stage adapter)
parent_receipts.gpu: parents/gpu_producer_receipt.json built only from verified gpu_fit/gpu_final transactions
parent_receipts.source: parents/source_producer_receipt.json built only from verified source_fit/source_final transactions
parent_receipts.timestamp_manifest: parents/v4_timestamp_parents.json with canonical file roles required by replica_v4_timestamp.py
parent_receipts.publication_trust_boundary: --published-source-sha256 attests a reviewed public commit; local byte equality alone does not prove publication. Real modes additionally verify Git HEAD contains identical source/spec/license bytes.
